name: ZCL_DEMO_HELPER
definition:
CLASS zcl_demo_helper DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: 
      get_user_name
        IMPORTING iv_user_id TYPE char12
        RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string,
      set_cache
        IMPORTING iv_cache TYPE string.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_cache TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.
implementation:
CLASS zcl_demo_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_user_name.
    " Logika pre získanie mena
    rv_name = 'Ján Novák'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_cache.
    mv_cache = iv_cache.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
